page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance from the High Clock Speed family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. The instance is built on the x86_64 architecture and features an Intel Xeon 6462C processor delivering a base frequency of 3.3 GHz across 8 dedicated vCPUs. It is paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The instance provides no hardware accelerators, with a GPU count of zero.

Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 8 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. The instance features no local storage, requiring network-attached cloud storage solutions for persistent disk management and operating system volumes. Because of the dedicated high-clock vCPU allocation and a compact memory profile, the instance provides cost efficiency for CPU-bound tasks where large RAM capacities or local disk arrays are unnecessary overhead.

The ecs.hfc8i.2xlarge is designed for compute-intensive workloads that demand stable processor frequencies rather than large memory footprints. Suitable deployment targets include web serving, continuous integration and build pipelines, batch compute processes, and application servers handling high request throughput.
